title: Octave Filter Bank
text: 倍频程频带和分数倍频程频带滤波器组，输入 1 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Bandwidth (octaves)} 指定以倍频程指定的滤波器带宽 1；{Frequency range (Hz)} 指定滤波器组的频率范围、{Reference frequency (Hz)} 指定滤波器组的参考频率、{Filter order} 指定倍频程滤波器的阶数、{Octave ratio} 指定滤波器之间的距离 Base ten、{Inherit sample rate from input} 允许由输入信号设置采样率、{Input sample rate (Hz)} 指定输入的采样率、{Bands as separate output ports} 指定每个滤波器频带一个输出端口、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted、{View filter response} 打开绘图以可视化幅值响应、{Variable name} 指定导出滤波器组的变量名、{Overwrite variable if it already exists} 指定如果变量已存在则覆盖、{Export filter to workspace} 指定将滤波器组导出到工作区，按实例取值。

params.name: Bandwidth (octaves)
params.values: 以倍频程指定的滤波器带宽 1 octave (default) | 2/3 octave | 1/2 octave | 1/3 octave | 1/6 octave | 1/12 octave | 1/24 octave | 1/48 octave

params.name: Frequency range (Hz)
params.values: 滤波器组的频率范围 (Hz) [22 22050] (default) | two-element row vector of positive monotonically increasing values

params.name: Reference frequency (Hz)
params.values: 滤波器组的参考频率 (Hz) 1000 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Filter order
params.values: 倍频程滤波器的阶数 12 (default) | positive even integer

params.name: Octave ratio
params.values: 滤波器之间的距离 Base ten (ANSI S1.11 preferred) (default) | Base two (musical scale)

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: 允许由输入信号设置采样率 off (default) | on

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 输入的采样率 44100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Bands as separate output ports
params.values: 每个滤波器频带一个输出端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: View filter response
params.values: 打开绘图以可视化幅值响应 button

params.name: Variable name
params.values: 导出滤波器组的变量名 myFilt (default) | valid variable name

params.name: Overwrite variable if it already exists
params.values: 如果变量已存在则覆盖 on (default) | off

params.name: Export filter to workspace
params.values: 将滤波器组导出到工作区 button
